(Andrew Cornaga/Photosport via AP) Chennai Here is everything you need to know about the second T20I between India and New Zealand at the Hagley Oval on Saturday. India and New Zealand will lock horns again in the second T20I at the Hagley Oval in Christchurch on Saturday. India leads the five-match T20I series 1-0 after winning the first T20I by four wickets in a high-scoring game. Batting first, New Zealand posted 225/4 powered by Glenn Phillips’ unbeaten 82 off 40 balls. In reply, India openers Sanju Samson and Abhishek Sharma set the tone early with some swashbuckling shots in the Powerplay to help the visitor score 94 runs in the first six. Then, Shreyas Iyer (42 off 28 balls) and Naman Dhir’s cameo (42* off 15 balls) helped India overhaul the target with two balls to spare, and register its highest ever chase in T20Is in the process. For the visitor, Ishan Kishan has been ruled out of the second T20I with a groin strain, with teenage sensation Vaibhav Sooryavanshi in line to take his place. When is the India vs New Zealand second T20I? The India vs New Zealand second T20I will take place at the Hagley Oval in Christchurch on Saturday, October 24. What time is the India vs New Zealand second T20I? The India vs New Zealand second T20I is scheduled to begin at 12:30 PM IST. What time is the toss for the India vs New Zealand second T20I? The toss for the India vs New Zealand second T20I is scheduled to take place at 12:00 PM IST. Where will the India vs New Zealand second T20I be streamed live? The India vs New Zealand second T20I will be streamed live on the Sony LIV app and website, and televised live on the Sony Sports Network.
